blocking.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
blocking.text: Make sure that each subagent does a dry run.
blocking.problem: In review.md line 233, item 6 of "After the self-check: the reader test" comes after item 5, which already starts the reader subagents, but the dry run is set only by the prompt at the start of each subagent.
blocking.correction: Remove item 6 and add to item 5, before "Give each task to a different new subagent.": "Use the reader prompt below for each reader. The first line of the reader prompt tells the subagent to do a dry run."

advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: Give their identifiers to the runner of the project, for example with `--ids 3,7`.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md, line 327, the technical noun "runner" is not in the glossary or in the base list, and the file does not define it.
advisory.correction: Give their identifiers to the test command of the project, for example with `--ids 3,7`.

advisory.heading: When you select a technical noun
advisory.text: Save the screen text to the screen-text file in the round folder.
advisory.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/review.md, line 356, the multi-word noun "screen-text file" is not in the glossary or in the base list, and the file uses "the" as if a different sentence defined it.
advisory.correction: Save the screen text to a file in the round folder. At the first save, make a new file. At each later save, add the text to the end of that file. (Then in line 360, write "the path of the file with the screen text".)
